name: Wailing Essence
summary: In the Wailing Caverns, Wailing Essence gathers within roaming ectoplasms. Alchemists seek its potent properties, while nearby druids dread the mutations spreading through the Barrens.

sections.title: A Volatile Concoction
sections.body:
Beneath the central Barrens, unnatural energy twists beasts and gives rise to gelatinous ectoplasms. Within them lies a viscous substance called Wailing Essence. Nearby druids watch the waters with growing dread, while goblin traders see a chance for profit.

In Ratchet, Mebok Mizzyrix believes the essence is the missing ingredient for a lucrative line of “smart drinks” meant to sharpen the mind. The eccentric alchemist gives little thought to the corruption they might carry.

faq.q: Where does Wailing Essence come from?
faq.answer: Wailing Essence comes from ectoplasmic slimes in the Wailing Caverns. Devouring ectoplasms, evolving ectoplasms, and nightmare ectoplasms all hold it.
Mebok Mizzyrix, a goblin experimenter in Ratchet, wants the essence for a new formula of his intellect-boosting “smart drinks.”

faq.q: What is the essence suspected of doing to the Barrens?
faq.answer: Mebok suspects the essence makes wildlife mutate rapidly and unnatural plant growth spread across the Barrens.

faq.q: Is drinking Wailing Essence actually safe?
faq.answer: Drinking Wailing Essence is reckless. It comes from corrupt, nightmare-tainted ectoplasms deep in a cursed cavern, yet Mebok plans to put it in a commercial drink.

angles.text: As a druid, you can read Wailing Essence as a sign of corruption deep within the Wailing Caverns and of the urgent need to cleanse the Dream’s taint.
